payload.title: Adaro Reports Strong Cash Flow on Metallurgical and Thermal Coal Shipments
payload.summary: Adaro maintained production targets of 65-67 million tonnes of coal, generating record operational cash flow while scouting industrial park aluminum smelter investments.

payload.title: Adaro Prepares Spin-Off of Thermal Coal Assets to Accelerate Green Narrative
payload.summary: Adaro Energy announced corporate restructuring to separate thermal coal business, though thermal coal revenue still represents over 82% of current consolidated revenue.
